import java.util.*;

public class MaxFlowMinCost {
    static class Line {
        int nxt, t, c, l;
        Line(int nxt, int t, int c, int l) {
            this.nxt = nxt;
            this.t = t;
            this.c = c;
            this.l = l;
        }
    }

    static final int Maxn = 5500;
    static final int Maxm = 35500;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static List<Line> g = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] fir = new int[Maxn];
    static int tl;
    static int S, T;
    static int[] pre = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] lp = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] flow = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] dis = new int[Maxn];
    static boolean[] in = new boolean[Maxn];

    static int n, m, k, C, D;
    static int[][] pl = new int[105][105];
    static int[][] st = new int[105][105];

    static class Data {
        int f, t;
        Data(int f, int t) {
            this.f = f;
            this.t = t;
        }
    }

    static Data[] s = new Data[105];

    static int[] queue = new int[Maxn];

    static int P(int x, int y) {
        return x * n + y;
    }

    static void adl(int f, int t, int c, int cost) {
        g.add(new Line(fir[f], t, c, cost));
        fir[f] = g.size() - 1;
        g.add(new Line(fir[t], f, 0, -cost));
        fir[t] = g.size() - 1;
    }

    static int spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
        flow[S] = INF;
        dis[S] = 0;
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        queue[tail++] = S;
        in[S] = true;

        while (head < tail) {
            int u = queue[head++];
            in[u] = false;
            for (int i = fir[u]; i != 0; i = g.get(i).nxt) {
                int v = g.get(i).t;
                if (g.get(i).c > 0 && dis[v] > dis[u] + g.get(i).l) {
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + g.get(i).l;
                    flow[v] = Math.min(flow[u], g.get(i).c);
                    lp[v] = i;
                    pre[v] = u;
                    if (!in[v]) {
                        in[v] = true;
                        queue[tail++] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return flow[T];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        D = sc.nextInt();

        Arrays.fill(fir, 0);
        g.clear();
        tl = 1;

        S = P(n + k, n) + 1;
        T = S + 2;

        adl(P(0, 1), T, INF, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int p = sc.nextInt();
            adl(S, P(0, p), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int f1 = sc.nextInt();
            int t1 = sc.nextInt();
            s[i * 2] = new Data(f1, t1);
            s[i * 2 - 1] = new Data(t1, f1);
        }
        m *= 2;

        for (int t = 1; t <= n + k; t++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                adl(P(t - 1, i), P(t, i), INF, 0);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                adl(P(t - 1, s[i].f), P(t, s[i].t), 1, D);
                pl[t][i] = tl;
                st[t][i] = 1;
            }
            adl(P(t, 1), T, INF, t * C);
        }

        int cans = 0;
        while (true) {
            int sav = spfa();
            if (sav == 0) break;
            int u = T;
            while (u != S) {
                int las = pre[u];
                g.get(lp[u]).c -= sav;
                g.get(lp[u] ^ 1).c += sav;
                u = las;
            }
            cans += dis[T] * sav;
            for (int t = 1; t <= n + n; t++) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                    if (g.get(pl[t][i]).c > 0) {
                        st[t][i]++;
                        adl(P(t - 1, s[i].f), P(t, s[i].t), 1, D * (st[t][i] * 2 - 1));
                        pl[t][i] = tl;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(cans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
